operations.new_text: Gate~5 uses four prospective roofs on one frozen callable interface. The primary roof is \(\rho_{\rm phys}=\tau_{6a}\), derived from the unchanged \texttt{d=6a} collision geometry. The unit control is \(\rho_{\rm unit}=c_0\) with a positive constant \(c_0\) frozen before output access. A lawful shuffled control is \(\rho_{\rm shuf}=\rho_{\rm phys}\circ\phi\), where \(\phi\) must be a predeclared adjacency-preserving H\"older automorphism of the coding interface; if no such map is supplied, the shuffle is \path{CONTROL_NOT_EVALUABLE}. The neighboring-geometry control is \(\rho_\delta=\tau_{(6+\delta)a}\), where an exact nonzero rational \(\delta\) and the corresponding no-eclipse geometry must be frozen before use. This last roof is a control and does not alter the primary \texttt{d=6a} system. For each control \(c\), the pre-result contract registers \(\Delta_c=\sup_{s\in\Omega}|D_{\rm phys}(s)-D_c(s)|\), an exact positive rational threshold \(\eta_c>0\) serialized before output access, and a Gate-4 joint input-and-error enclosure \([L_c,U_c]\) for \(\Delta_c\). It returns \path{SEPARATED} if \(L_c>\eta_c\), \path{NOT_SEPARATED} if \(U_c\leq\eta_c\), and \path{INDETERMINATE} otherwise. The domain \(\Omega\), each \(\eta_c\), and every numerical enclosure remain \texttt{UNASSIGNED}; until they are frozen the gate is \path{CONTROL_NOT_EVALUABLE}. No control has been executed and no fidelity result exists.

Gate~3 binds orbit coefficients, traces, projected traces, and determinant coefficients under the same specification. Gate~4 consumes those bindings to produce, if possible, one domain-specific enclosure. Gate~5 compares the physical roof with independently constructed controls while preserving the same coding interface. Gate~6 is optional and directional: it consumes a separately registered pair of roofs and an applicable scalar cohomology theorem map. A later gate cannot retroactively validate an earlier one.
operations.new_text: The certificate is a directed acyclic graph. Gate~1 consumes frozen geometry and owner policy and would emit a hashed pointwise-roof and orbit-owner ledger; Gate~2 consumes that hash and would emit an operator specification and theorem-hypothesis receipt; Gate~3 consumes both and would emit a coefficient-correspondence ledger; Gate~4 consumes those ledgers plus five uncertainty-channel records and would emit a domain-specific enclosure receipt; Gate~5 consumes the same coding, operator, error, and replay interfaces and would emit a physical-versus-control comparison receipt. Gates~1--5 are the mandatory chain. Gate~6 consumes a separately registered roof pair and theorem map only when activated. Every gate record must name input and output hashes, uncertainty channels, validator version, downstream consumers, and prohibited claims. The closed states are \texttt{NOT\_STARTED}, \texttt{PREREQUISITE\_BLOCKED}, \texttt{EVALUABLE}, \texttt{PASSED}, \texttt{FAILED}, and \texttt{NOT\_EVALUABLE}; Gate~6 additionally admits \texttt{NOT\_ACTIVATED}.
